def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    spot_rate = 2.0979
    sterling_interest_rate = 1.6025 / 100
    kiwi_interest_rate = 3.2875 / 100
    days = 180
    basis_points_per_unit = 10000

    # Calculate the NZD/GBP forward rate and forward points
    forward_rate = spot_rate * (
        (1 + kiwi_interest_rate * days / 360)
        / (1 + sterling_interest_rate * days / 360)
    )
    forward_points = (forward_rate - spot_rate) * basis_points_per_unit

    # return answer
    return round(forward_points, 3)
